def einsum_flop_jit(inputs: List[Any], outputs: List[Any]) -> Number:
    """
    Count flops for the einsum operation.
    """
    # inputs[0] is the equation string, inputs[1:] are the input tensors
    equation = inputs[0].toIValue()
    # Parse the equation to get input and output subscripts
    # Remove spaces
    equation = equation.replace(' ', '')
    
    # Split into input and output parts
    input_str, output_str = equation.split('->')
    input_operands = input_str.split(',')
    
    # Get shapes of input tensors
    input_shapes = [get_shape(v) for v in inputs[1:]]
    
    # Build a mapping from dimension letter to size
    letter_to_dim = {}
    for operand, shape in zip(input_operands, input_shapes):
        for letter, size in zip(operand, shape):
            letter_to_dim[letter] = size
    
    # Total flops = product of all unique dimensions
    flops = prod(list(letter_to_dim.values()))
    return flops
